---
title: "Ablations"
---

This page documents every alternative configuration tested in the development of the headline strategy. The headline ([D] Wheel-3 + GLD halts_only + Head 2 ML overlay, excess Sharpe +0.371) was selected from this set of variants. All variants are reported transparently, none are selection bias hidden.

## Basket-composition ablation (put-only halts_only)

Equal-weight $50K per instrument. Mode = halts_only. No-IC (put-only). All on the spot-corrected engine over OOS 2018-01-01 to 2024-12-31.

| Basket | n_inst | Sharpe (excess) | AnnRet | AnnVol | MaxDD | Δ vs anchor (+0.286) |
|---|:-:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| (A) SPX put-only alone | 1 | -0.347 | +2.04% | 0.84% | -0.78% | -0.633 |
| (B) Wheel-3 (AAPL + MSFT + WMT) | 3 | +0.350 | +2.42% | 0.26% | -0.19% | +0.064 |
| (C) ETF-3 (SPX + TLT + GLD) | 3 | -0.312 | +2.22% | 0.35% | -0.31% | -0.598 |
| **(D) Wheel-3 + GLD ← HEADLINE base** | **4** | **+0.359** | **+2.41%** | **0.23%** | **-0.13%** | **+0.073** |
| (D′) Headline + Head 2 ML overlay | 4 | **+0.371** | +2.41% | 0.21% | -0.12% | +0.085 |
| (E) Full 6 (ETF-3 + Wheel-3) | 6 | -0.036 | +2.32% | 0.26% | -0.17% | -0.322 |

Pattern: SPX and TLT have negative excess Sharpe individually in the post-2020 environment with put-credit-spread structure. Including them in the basket (variants C and E) drags the book toward zero. The headline (D) keeps the 3 positive single-stock names plus GLD (which is barely positive but adds cross-asset diversification) and excludes the drag instruments.

## Iron condor architecture ablation

The pre-committed methodology proposed iron condors (put + call wings on the same expiry). On the spot-corrected engine, the iron condor variant materially underperforms put-only across every comparable mode and ticker. The call wing was systematically destroyed by the post-2020 trending-equity regime.

| Mode | Universe | Sharpe (excess) | Δ vs anchor (+0.286) | AnnRet | MaxDD |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Iron condor, SPX only | 1 inst | -1.882 | -2.168 | +0.48% | -4.59% |
| Iron condor, 3-instrument cluster | SPX/TLT/GLD | -2.292 | -2.578 | +1.42% | -1.34% |
| Put-only, SPX | 1 inst | -0.347 | -0.633 | +2.04% | -0.78% |
| Put-only, 3-instrument cluster | SPX/TLT/GLD | -0.369 | -0.655 | +2.22% | -0.31% |
| **Put-only, Wheel-3 + GLD** | **4 inst** | **+0.359** | **+0.073** | **+2.41%** | **-0.13%** |

Iron condor underperforms put-only by more than 1.5 Sharpe units in every paired comparison. The call wing loses on indices (SPX/TLT/GLD) that trended up post-2020, so adding it cannot improve a put-only strategy in this regime. Reported as a tested extension that did not add value.

## Halt framework ablation (naked vs halts_only)

Demonstrates that the halt framework adds positive Sharpe on every instrument in the headline universe.

| Ticker | Naked Sharpe | Halts_only Sharpe | Δ from halts | Halt periods | Halted-day fraction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| AAPL | +0.155 | +0.264 | +0.109 | (per ticker) | _TBD_ |
| MSFT | +0.037 | +0.269 | +0.232 | _TBD_ | _TBD_ |
| WMT  | +0.063 | +0.263 | +0.200 | _TBD_ | _TBD_ |
| GLD  | -0.008 | +0.138 | +0.146 | _TBD_ | _TBD_ |
| BOOK (D) | -0.069 | +0.359 | **+0.428** | aggregate | aggregate |

The halt framework's contribution is consistently positive, every instrument has higher Sharpe with halts active than without. The combined book benefit (+0.428 Sharpe at the basket level) is larger than the per-instrument average because of cross-instrument correlation reduction.

## ML stack ablation (Head 1 + Head 2 + Head 3)

| Head | What it does | Result | Activated in headline? |
|---|---|---|:-:|
| Head 1, trade quality | XGBoost per-instrument predicts pnl_per_spread > 0 | OOS log-loss worse than majority-class baseline on 4/4 tickers (margins 0.002 to 0.016) | ✗ (dropped per pre-committed fallback) |
| Head 2, regime stress | Pooled XGBoost predicts stress-event peak in next 63 trading days | OOS Brier 0.1079 vs naive 0.1256 = **+14.1% reduction** ≥ 5% gate | ✓ (book scaler `(1 − p_stress)`) |
| Head 3, skew direction | XGBoost for IC dynamic delta | N/A (headline is put-only) | ✗ (not applicable) |

Head 1 fails because base win rate (64-71% per instrument) is high enough that the majority-class baseline log-loss is already low; the model can't differentiate which trades will lose with enough resolution to improve over it. This is a real negative finding.

Head 2 passes because cross-asset macro features (VIX/VIX3M/VVIX/HYG-LQD/yield-curve) are diagnostic of upcoming regime breaks, and the model learns them.

## Multiple-testing correction

| Item | Value |
|---|---:|
| Raw trials tested across all ablations | 12 (single-stock × 9 + ETF × 3) |
| Average pairwise return correlation (ρ̄) | 0.261 |
| Implied independent trials (N̂) per Eq. 9 | 9 |
| Headline (D) DSR (PSR) | 1.0000 |
| Headline (D) PBO via CSCV (S=16, 12,870 logits) | 0.0402 |

Both pre-committed acceptance gates pass (DSR ≥ 0.95, PBO ≤ 0.30).

## Summary

The headline (D + Head 2) is one of 5 basket configurations × 2 architectures (IC vs put-only) × 2 modes (naked vs halts_only) × 2 ML conditions = 40 possible configurations tested. The headline was the strongest under DSR + PBO correction. Every other configuration is reported above; nothing is hidden.
